cases.assertion: Reject missing, null and non-list data plus non-dict envelopes from transformer and saved-file loader without acquiring a connection.
Reject invalid record objects, ids, range, bool ids and blank/non-string names even after a valid first record; preserve input.
Reject duplicate ids for both identical and conflicting records before acquiring a connection.
Reject invalid nested collection containers, non-dict members, non-string urls and invalid uid types across the entire batch.
Allow absent/null/empty nested values, integer or string uid values and unrecognized urls; preserve caller data and deterministic transformation.
Explicit empty batches return zero and malformed JSON retains JSONDecodeError; neither acquires a database connection.

Inject failure after the second write through each public persistence seam. All prior-row updates and new rows roll back, earlier files stay durable, and retrying the unchanged saved file succeeds with stable counts.
Across separate committed transactions, identical records containing SQL NULLs and reordered nested JSON keys preserve every persisted value and all game/category/link timestamps.
Changed metadata advances game timestamps, remapped categories advance category timestamps, store identifiers retain unique remapping semantics, and omitted links/categories remain present.
Persist verbatim names and raw_json, UTC release dates, numeric enums with decoded labels, Steam URL-over-uid and websites-over-external precedence; return distinct game counts.
Exercise all original persistence helpers through the public loader using a conventional fake connection/cursor.
The established dispatcher routes an IGDB bronze filename to the public IGDB file loader exactly once.

limitations: The supplied public interface does not document exact transformed dictionary keys or helper argument shapes. Compatibility is checked through public loader observations and a conventional fake cursor, rather than inventing private record contracts.
Enum decoding is checked for retained numeric values and nonempty labels because exact label strings are not supplied in the public contract.
Tests are authored blind and have not executed candidate code. Real PostgreSQL cases require the unchanged test_database/db fixtures and a reachable fixture database.
